title: CmdPal: Fix item subscription races during cleanup (part 1)

status.label: Review in progress
status.detail: Live head remains 952d380886abf321658ee61be75ea04b27f597d2 and the upstream PR is still conflicting. A non-force merge of the current fork base 875be8f05ae9cccca81ea19bdad22c5057bbb8b2 into fork branch pr-iterate/50487 was attempted and stopped on content conflicts in CommandItemViewModel.cs, CommandViewModel.cs, and ListItemViewModel.cs; the merge was aborted, so the durable branch remains clean at f5fbec3956dfcfe4d059fa3509122806f2fb87dd.

next_action: Reconcile the preserved fork head against the fast-forwarded base without force-pushing or duplicating PR/review state; then rebuild and revalidate the exact upstream tree.

upstream_grounding.reason: The saved Copilot finding targets code present only in the preserved fork review tree, not the current upstream PR diff. The fork base branch is now current, but the fork PR metadata still reports the prior base snapshot and the fork head has not been rebased or rebuilt against the current upstream tree.

reconciliation.remediation: Resolve these lifecycle/context-menu conflicts in the fork local checkout, commit the merge, and push the resulting descendant to pr-iterate/50487 without force-pushing. Then recheck fork PR 754, ground against upstream head 952d380886abf321658ee61be75ea04b27f597d2, and run exact-head validation before any new Copilot request.
